name: Default
shortDescription: Web tool to bulk unsubscribe from newsletters, delete, archive, label and mark Gmail messages as read by sender, using your own Google OAuth client.

alerts.message: Requires your own Google Cloud OAuth client: enable the Gmail API, add your address as a test user, create a Web application client with the authorized redirect URI http://oauth.<your domain>:80/ and replace the credentials.json mount with the downloaded JSON.
After clicking Sign In, the Google authorization URL is printed in the container logs. Open it within 5 minutes to finish signing in.
The web UI has no login of its own: anyone who can reach the URL can act on the connected Gmail account. Sign out when you are done.
